notice: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Ground truth for a fictional letter written for evaluation only. Not a real document; all personal data is invented.

summary_points.en: The immigration office invites you to an in-person appointment to extend your student residence permit.
summary_points.tr: Yabancılar dairesi, öğrenci oturum izninin uzatılması için seni yüz yüze bir randevuya çağırıyor.
summary_points.source_quote: Zur Bearbeitung Ihres Verlängerungsantrags laden wir Sie zu einem persönlichen Termin ein:

summary_points.en: Your current residence permit is valid until 15 November 2026.
summary_points.tr: Mevcut oturum iznin 15 Kasım 2026'ya kadar geçerli.

summary_points.en: The fee is up to 98.00 euros and must be paid by card at the appointment.
summary_points.tr: Harç en fazla 98,00 euro ve randevuda kartla ödenmesi gerekiyor.
summary_points.source_quote: Die Gebühr für die Verlängerung beträgt bis zu 98,00 Euro und ist beim Termin per Girocard zu entrichten.

summary_points.en: If the extension was applied for before the permit expires, the current permit continues to apply until a decision is made; a Fiktionsbescheinigung can be issued on request.
summary_points.tr: Uzatma başvurusu izin bitmeden yapıldıysa, karar verilene kadar mevcut izin geçerli sayılır; istenirse Fiktionsbescheinigung düzenlenebilir.
summary_points.source_quote: Wurde die Verlängerung vor Ablauf Ihres Aufenthaltstitels beantragt, gilt dieser bis zur Entscheidung als fortbestehend (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG).

description.en: Appointment at the immigration office: Rathausplatz 1, Building B, Room 2.14.
description.tr: Yabancılar dairesinde randevu: Rathausplatz 1, B Binası, 2.14 numaralı oda.

deadlines.rule: At least three Werktage before the appointment on 2026-10-28.
deadlines.uncertainty_reason: 'Werktage' may or may not include Saturday, so the last possible day is ambiguous (2026-10-23 or 2026-10-24). The app should show the rule, not present a single computed date as certain.

description.en: Cancel the appointment by email if you cannot attend.

deadlines.source_quote: sagen Sie ihn bitte spätestens drei Werktage vorher per E-Mail an auslaenderbehoerde@musterstadt.example ab.

description.en: Attend the appointment on 28 October 2026 at 09:30.
Bring the listed documents in original.

items.en: Current biometric passport photo (max. 6 months old)
items.tr: Güncel biyometrik vesikalık fotoğraf (en fazla 6 aylık)
items.source_quote: 2. aktuelles biometrisches Passfoto (nicht älter als 6 Monate)

items.en: Proof of financing for at least 12 months (e.g. blocked account, formal obligation, scholarship)
items.tr: En az 12 aylık finansman belgesi (ör. bloke hesap, taahhütname, burs belgesi)
items.source_quote: 5. Finanzierungsnachweis (z. B. Sperrkonto, Verpflichtungserklärung oder Stipendienbescheinigung) für mindestens 12 Monate

items.en: Study progress certificate or transcript from the university
items.tr: Üniversiteden öğrenim durum belgesi veya not dökümü

actions.source_quote: Bitte bringen Sie folgende Unterlagen im Original mit:

description.en: Be ready to pay a fee of up to 98.00 euros by card at the appointment.
description.tr: Randevuda en fazla 98,00 euro harcı kartla ödemeye hazır ol.

actions.source_quote: Die Gebühr für die Verlängerung beträgt bis zu 98,00 Euro und ist beim Termin per Girocard zu entrichten.

condition.en: If you cannot attend the appointment

description.en: Cancel by email at least three working days before; a new appointment will be sent by letter.
description.tr: En az üç iş günü önce e-postayla iptal et; yeni randevu yazılı olarak bildirilecek.

actions.source_quote: sagen Sie ihn bitte spätestens drei Werktage vorher per E-Mail an auslaenderbehoerde@musterstadt.example ab.

description.en: Ask for a Fiktionsbescheinigung (a certificate that your current permit continues to apply).
description.tr: Fiktionsbescheinigung (mevcut iznin geçerli olmaya devam ettiğini gösteren belge) iste.

actions.source_quote: Auf Wunsch stellen wir Ihnen hierüber eine Fiktionsbescheinigung aus.

eval_notes: Tests an ambiguous relative deadline (Werktage) that must be flagged rather than computed with false certainty, the document list as a single checklist action, and that the permit expiry date is surfaced.
